repos_data.description: Official MCP server for Odds-API.io: live sports betting odds from 365+ bookmakers in Claude, Cursor and other AI tools

Python MCP server for ParlayAPI sports odds and props. Public discovery needs no key; account data uses your own key. Includes signup, login-email, checkout-link and preference actions. MIT code; API data redistribution rights are not included.
Official TheRundown data MCP. Six read-only Product API tools, hosted at https://mcp.therundown.io/mcp or run locally over stdio.
